$description: Tier 2 · Semantic roles. Emitted as --* (no prefix). The canonical roles are named as in Figma's Unicron / Theme collection (surface-ground, text-body, primary-fill …): each reads a theme slot, the stone slot in light (`$value`) and the graphite slot in dark (`$extensions["unicron.modes"].dark`). The shadcn/ui contract and the sidebar contract stay, as aliases of those roles, so existing classes keep working. No role points at the legacy neutral ramp; success, warning and info keep their accent ramps. Apps add their own roles in an extension layer (see examples/app-extension.css), never here.

unicron.theme.$description: Extra entries for the Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block. Radius steps are multiples of --radius: every step is 1, so every rounded-* class draws the one 2px corner. Spacing names become sizing utilities (h-control, size-control, min-h-touch-min).

surface-ground.$description: Figma surface/ground. The page background. Also the label on an active Filter Chip, where ink and ground swap.

surface-raised.$description: Figma surface/raised. Raised controls and cards: the tab bar, a float button, a text field's box, menus, dialogs, a chat bubble, tiles.

surface-scrim.$description: Figma surface/scrim. The full-screen dim behind sheets, dialogs and menus. The colour only: the layer's opacity is a tier 3 knob (--c-scrim-sheet, -dialog, -menu). Never opaque, never blurred.

line-rule.$description: Figma line/rule. Hairline rules and 1px borders, a field's resting border included. Also the empty part of a progress bar. Quiet by design: its contrast is reported, not gated (scripts/contrast.mjs).

line-grid-dot.$description: Figma line/grid-dot. The dot grid, and the grabber of a sheet.

text-body.$description: Figma text/body. Main text and, by default, icons. Also the Secondary button's border, the unread mark and an active Filter Chip's fill. Solved to APCA Lc 90 on the ground.

text-secondary.$description: Figma text/secondary. Supporting text: helper lines, descriptions, a banner's body, an inactive nav label. Solved to APCA Lc 75 on the ground.

text-label.$description: Figma text/label. Labels, meta lines, overlines, counts, placeholders, inactive tab icons. Solved to APCA Lc 60 on the ground.

text-faint.$description: Figma text/faint. The faintest text: the index number in a Nav Item or a Top Tab. It has no contrast target, so it never carries what a person needs to read; its contrast is reported, not gated.

primary-fill.$description: Figma primary/fill. The app's identity as a solid: the one primary action of a screen, the selected-row edge, the tab indicator, a switch that is on, a field's focus border, the app mark.

primary-on-fill.$description: Figma primary/on-fill. Text and icons on primary-fill. Solved to APCA Lc 75.

primary-text.$description: Figma primary/text. The identity as small text, or as an icon on primary-soft. Solved to APCA Lc 60 on the ground.

primary-soft.$description: Figma primary/soft. The quiet identity tint: a selected row, the current nav item, the active dock tab, a calendar event, an artifact tile. Selection is this fill plus a 2px primary-fill edge, never a solid.

primary-display.$description: Figma primary/display. The identity as large type, 36px and up. Solved to APCA Lc 45, so it stays closer to the identity hue than primary-text. Never under 36px.

secondary-live.$description: Figma secondary/live. Live activity and agents only: live status text, the filled part of a progress bar, the live mark, an agent message's meta. Not the shadcn `secondary`, which is a neutral fill.

needs-you-fill.$description: Figma needs-you/fill. The yellow block that waits on the person, the same in every app and both grounds. Also the label on the dark needs-you button. At most one per screen.

needs-you-on-fill.$description: Figma needs-you/on-fill. Text on the yellow; also the fill of the solid needs-you button and the border of the outline one.

critical-fill.$description: Figma critical/fill. Error as a solid: the destructive button, an invalid field's 2px border, a critical banner's edge.

critical-text.$description: Figma critical/text. Error text and a critical banner's icon.

critical-soft.$description: Figma critical/soft. A critical banner's background.

state-hover.$description: The hover wash on a neutral or transparent control or row: 6% of the ink, laid over whatever is underneath. Not in Figma, which draws no states. A solid fill shows hover as itself at 90% instead.

state-pressed.$description: The pressed wash: 10% of the ink. Not in Figma. A solid fill shows pressed as itself at 80% instead.

diff-added.$description: The wash behind an added line of a diff: a neutral wash, 8% of the ink in the ground, the same rule in every app (cross-app decisions §11: Synapse's primary-soft and critical-soft read as one colour, so an identity tint cannot mark added lines). Not in Figma. The + mark always shows: colour never carries the meaning alone.

diff-removed.$description: The wash behind a removed line of a diff. The − mark always shows.

swatch-01.$description: Swatch 01 of 12 (red, hue 25): a person's colour for a calendar, a note, a label. A 2px bar, edge or an 8px square; holds Lc 60 as text on surface-ground and surface-raised in every mode. Never a status, never a fill behind text.

background.$description: The page. An alias of surface-ground, kept for the shadcn contract.

foreground.$description: Main text. An alias of text-body, kept for the shadcn contract.

card.$description: A raised surface. An alias of surface-raised, kept for the shadcn contract.

popover.$description: A menu, a popover, a dialog: solid surface-raised, never glass.

primary.$description: The app's identity as a solid. An alias of primary-fill, kept for the shadcn contract. It was near-black before 1.0: it is now the app's colour, for the one primary action of a screen.

secondary.$description: The shadcn neutral fill (bg-secondary). An alias of surface-raised. Not Figma's secondary/live: that is secondary-live.

muted.$description: A quiet fill: a track, a key. An alias of surface-raised.

support-foreground.$description: Support text: the lines that explain, under a title or beside a value. An alias of text-secondary (APCA Lc 75).

muted-foreground.$description: Labels and meta: when, how many, captions, overlines, placeholders, inactive tabs, keys. An alias of text-label (APCA Lc 60).

muted-foreground-on-fill.$description: The same ink inside a fill. It was a shade stronger than muted-foreground on the old ramp; Figma has one label ink, so the two are now equal. Kept because fills re-point --muted-foreground at it (@unicron/ui's styles).

faint-foreground.$description: The faintest ink. An alias of text-faint; see its limits there.

accent.$description: The hover and highlight fill of an item in a list or a menu: 8% of the ink in surface-raised. Opaque, so it also works where a wash cannot (a sticky row, a menu item over a shadowless popup).

destructive.$description: Destructive and error text. An alias of critical-text. The solid is critical-fill, the wash critical-soft.

warning.$description: Something is wrong. A fill that holds a label (--warning-foreground at APCA Lc 75 or more), and shows against the ground, a raised surface and a selected row (Lc 30 or more). Also an ink for a warning glyph: Lc 60 or more on the ground. Keeps the amber ramp; the steps were re-picked at 1.0, when text on a fill went from Lc 60 to Lc 75.

warning-foreground.$description: The label on --warning: white on the darker light-mode amber, near-black on the lighter dark-mode one.

info.$description: For your information. A fill that holds a label (--info-foreground at APCA Lc 75 or more), and shows against the ground, a raised surface and a selected row (Lc 30 or more). Also an ink: Lc 60 or more on the ground. Keeps the blue ramp; the steps were re-picked at 1.0, when text on a fill went from Lc 60 to Lc 75.

info-foreground.$description: The label on --info: white on the darker light-mode blue, near-black on the lighter dark-mode one.

success.$description: Done, worked, complete. The fill: a mark, an orb, a bar. Lc 30 or more against the ground, a raised surface, a selected row and its own wash. It carries no text; words in this role use --success-foreground. Keeps the green ramp.

success-foreground.$description: Success as text and icons: coloured text, Lc 60 or more on the ground, a raised surface, a selected row and --success-surface (it measures Lc 67 or more).

success-surface.$description: A quiet success wash behind a row, a card or a callout, under --success-foreground.

attention.$description: Waiting on the person. An alias of needs-you-fill: the yellow, in both grounds. As a fill it holds needs-you-on-fill text; as a small mark on stone it barely differs from the ground in lightness (scripts/contrast.mjs lists it), so pair it with a shape.

attention-foreground.$description: Attention as text and icons, on a surface: a readable amber on stone, where the yellow would not read, and the yellow itself on graphite. Coloured text: Lc 60 or more on the ground, a raised surface, a selected row and --attention-surface. On the yellow block itself, text is needs-you-on-fill.

attention-surface.$description: A quiet attention wash behind a row or a count, under --attention-foreground: a pale amber on stone, 14% of the yellow in the ground on graphite.

running.$description: Working now. An alias of secondary-live: the app's live colour.

running-foreground.$description: Running as text and icons. An alias of secondary-live (APCA Lc 60 on the ground).

running-surface.$description: A quiet running wash behind a row or a callout: 14% of the live colour in the ground.

border.$description: Separators and 1px borders. An alias of line-rule.

input.$description: A field's resting border. An alias of line-rule: Figma draws field borders as hairlines, so this no longer holds 3:1. A field is found by its surface-raised box; focus (2px primary-fill) and error (2px critical-fill) are the borders held to 3:1.

ring.$description: The focus ring: a solid 2px outline in the ink, offset 2px. An alias of text-body. A text field draws a 2px inside border in primary-fill instead.

radius.$description: The one corner: 2px (Figma radius/control). Every Tailwind step from rounded-xs to rounded-4xl draws it.

size-control.$description: 48px (Figma size/control): every floating control, the tab bar, the status strip, a text field's least height. Tailwind: h-control, size-control, min-h-control.

size-touch-min.$description: 44px (Figma size/touch-min): the floor for a touch target. Tailwind: min-h-touch-min, size-touch-min.

stroke-rule.$description: 1px: rules and borders. A stroke never adds height: on a part that hugs its content it is an inset shadow, not a border.

stroke-emphasis.$description: 2px: focus and error borders, the selected-row edge, the tab indicator.

motion-fast.$description: Small state changes and entrances: a hover, a press, a dialog or menu appearing. 120ms, the floor below which a change reads as a jump. Tailwind's default transition duration (`transition`, `transition-colors`) is mapped to it.

motion-base.$description: Larger moves: a sheet sliding in, a toast entering or leaving.

motion-press.$description: A control going down under a press. Release runs on motion-fast.

motion-state.$description: A surface changing state: a sheet or a panel opening, a selection moving.

motion-move.$description: Travel across the screen. The longest a default motion runs.

motion-tick.$description: One step of a countdown ring, run linear so it tracks the clock.

motion-ease-enter.$description: Things arriving: fast out, gentle settle. The same curve as motion-ease.

motion-ease-exit.$description: Things leaving: they gather speed and go. Pair it with a shorter duration than the entrance.

motion-ease-move.$description: Travel and resize: a selection moving, a panel changing height.

motion-ease-emphasis.$description: A slight overshoot for a rare moment, such as a success. Never on a control used many times a minute.

motion-ease-pulse.$description: The curve of a pulse loop.

motion-spring-settle.$description: A thumb or a pill arriving at a new place. Use as a timing function with motion-spring-settle-duration.

motion-spring-firm.$description: A sheet or another large surface arriving, with no visible bounce. Use with motion-spring-firm-duration.

motion-stagger.$description: The delay between siblings that enter in turn.

motion-stagger-max.$description: Siblings after this many start together.

motion-press-depth-small.$description: Scale of a pressed icon-size control.

motion-spin.$description: One turn of a spinner or a working ring, so live states turn at one rate in every app. Tailwind's animate-spin runs on it.

motion-pulse.$description: One beat of a pulse or a breathing halo (needs-you, thinking). Tailwind's animate-pulse runs on it.

motion-ease.$description: The one curve: fast out, gentle settle. Tailwind's default transition curve and `ease-standard` are mapped to it.

sidebar.$description: The sidebar sits on the page's own ground, set apart by space, not a fill.

sidebar-accent.$description: The current item of the sidebar: primary-soft.
